title: USFDA Closes Inspection at Aurobindo's Apitoria API Facility with VAI Status, 3 Observations

contentHtml:
Hyderabad: The United States Food and Drug Administration (USFDA) has classified Unit-VI, an active pharmaceutical ingredient (API) manufacturing facility of Apitoria Pharma Private Limited, a wholly owned subsidiary of Aurobindo Pharma Limited, as Voluntary Action Indicated (VAI).

This comes after an inspection conducted from August 24 to August 28, 2026. The facility, located at E-Bonangi Village, Parawada Mandal, Anakapalli District, Andhra Pradesh, received three observations during the inspection. The USFDA has now issued the Establishment Inspection Report (EIR), confirming the VAI classification and closure of the inspection.

The USFDA inspection covered the API manufacturing operations at Unit-VI. Following the inspection, the facility received three observations, after which the regulatory agency completed its assessment and issued the EIR.

The VAI classification indicates that the USFDA has identified issues for which the establishment is expected to undertake voluntary corrective actions. The agency has concluded the inspection, and the facility's inspection status has now been formally closed.

Aurobindo Pharma Limited is a pharmaceutical company headquartered in Hyderabad, Telangana, with operations in the pharmaceutical sector. Apitoria Pharma Private Limited, whose Unit-VI facility underwent the inspection, is a wholly owned subsidiary of the company.
